title: Share of children enrolled in upper secondary school
subtitle: Comparing [net](#dod:net-enrollment-ratio) and [gross enrollment ratios](#dod:gross-enrolment-ratio) for children in [upper secondary](#dod:upper-secondary-education) education. Net enrollment shows the share of children of upper secondary school age (between 15 and 18 years old) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment includes all children regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of the population of the same age group.
